title: Inter: Lautaro and Thuram Back in Training. Should Lautaro Start vs Atalanta? #Shorts
description:
Lautaro Martínez and Marcus Thuram are back with the group. We say Inter need Lautaro from the start in Bergamo.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=78

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

REPORTED — Lautaro Martínez and Marcus Thuram trained with the group on Tuesday at Appiano Gentile; it was Lautaro's first session with the group since his injury, and both should be in the squad in Bergamo on Sunday. Source: Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews, Nov 17.
REPORTED — Chivu will not rush Lautaro, and Thuram is further along and could start next to Francesco Pio Esposito. Source: Tuttosport via FCInter1908, Nov 18; Corriere dello Sport also expects one of the two to start on the bench.
CONFIRMED — Tickets are on sale for the Supercoppa against Lazio at San Siro on Tuesday, Dec 22, 3:00 PM ET (21:00 CET). Source: Inter.it, Nov 17.
NEXT UP — Atalanta vs Inter, Sunday, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET (20:45 CET), Serie A Matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
